counterplay: Turn hard as it dives: it turns only so fast
rationale: A magpie in swooping season (br-bhkz.3): let go in either direction, it climbs, finds whoever is winning (the most points in a derby, the leader in a race; the next best when that is the thrower) and dives on them: a peck that damages the part it hits and spins the car. One hit, then it flies off. It follows its target for seven seconds and turns only so fast, so a hard turn at the last moment can shake it.
